items.title: Mike De Lay Interview, 1970-11-14
items.q: My first regular job I ever had in my life was with Albert's cousin.

ctx.x: Anyway, just one day. Right. Well, first of all, for today.

Okay. What is today? Today's gotta be the 14th. Yesterday was Friday 13th. Friday 13th. You had a good day. November 14th. Okay, fine. And, Mike Delay. Good. From there. We go. One week. Twenty-five years. This time. Next week. Next week. Next, what today is? Saturday? Next Saturday we'll be here. Twenty-five years. From New Orleans. From New Orleans. From New Orleans. That's a lot of time. We're living here twenty-three years, right? You've been here for about fifteen that I know. No, this hour. Twenty-three…
